TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Elven Conclaves Faction.

Translations.Comment: 評議会 = conclave/council. Conveys organized, deliberative nature of elven society.
槍兵 = spear fighter/infantry. Elegant representation of elven foot soldiers.
都市守衛 = city guard. Defensive troops maintaining order in elven cities.
達人 = master/expert. Conveys elite skill and mastery in combat.
弓兵 = archer. Elves renowned for exceptional archery precision.
監視兵 = watcher/sentinel. Implies vigilance and protective nature.
矢砲 = bolt thrower. Elven siege weapon with precision engineering.
槍騎兵 = lance cavalry/mounted spearman. Elegant mounted elven troops.
掠奪者 = reaver/raider. Fast striking cavalry that withdraws swiftly.
戦車 = war chariot. Classic elven military vehicle.
鷲 = eagle (majestic bird). Majestic creature befitting elven forces.
竜騎士 = dragon knight. Elite warriors riding powerful dragons.
太古 = primordial/ancient. Emphasizes immense age and power.
グリフォン = gryphon (katakana). Mythological creature of legend.
貴族 = noble/aristocrat. Elven leader with authority and elegance.
魔法使い = mage/sorcerer. Master of elven magical arts.
魔剣士 = spellsword/magic swordsman. Martial-magical hybrid warrior.
